

The information on this page is largely superseded by [[jbocre: Lojbanic Forums|Lojbanic Forums]].

The web interface through which you can join this mailing list (and some others) is available at: [http://www.lojban.org/lsg2/]

[[Beginning Mailing List|Beginning Mailing List]] is the Wiki page that inspired the list's creation.

The list is intended to provide a forum for Lojbanic beginners to pose questions, without the worries they might have about the [[jbocre: Lojban mailing list|Lojban Mailing List]].

The existance of this list is '''not''' to say that asking questions on the other list is bad or appropriate. However, the number of beginning-ish questions being posted to [[jbocre: Lojban mailing list he other list|Lojban Mailing List he other list]] seems to be going down. The conclusion [[jbocre: Jay Kominek|Jay Kominek]] drew was that beginners are getting the idea that that list isn't a good place to ask questions, ''regardless of how that list is advertised''. So I created the beginner's list as a place where it is made '''''explicitly''''' clear that beginners are welcome to ask questions.
